description.narrative: Pension reform is one of the key issues in the Government agenda. Several activities have been conductedcomma with support from the Bank and other donorscomma to assess the main problems of the current pension systemcomma particularly in terms of financial sustainability. The Government has created a commission in charge of following-up the pension reform debate in Morocco and proposing a reform strategy. During FY04 a national conference on pension reform will take place. The current report is being prepared at the request of the Government of Morocco. The specific objectives of the report are the following: a) To present an integrated assessmentcomma based on prior and new analytical workcomma of key issues facing the Moroccan pension system in the following areas: (i) financing; (ii) incentives; (iii) equity; (iv) coverage; and (v) governancecomma accountabilitycomma and investment policies. b) On the basis of international experiences and recent Bank work in other countries of the regioncomma identify (i) options for reform which are feasible in the Moroccan context; (ii) the costs and benefits of these reforms; and (iii) an integrated multi-year program for implementing these reforms.
